name: Euler Ancestral (VE path)
plain: Takes an Euler step past the next noise level, then adds fresh noise to climb back. The injected noise means the path is not a deterministic ODE path. This entry is the non-flow branch; flow models go to the RF entry.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
get_ancestral_step: σ_up=min(σ', η·√(σ'²(σ²−σ'²)/σ²)); σ_down=√(σ'²−σ_up²); η=0 returns (σ', 0).
x'=x+d·(σ_down−σ)+n·s_noise·σ_up. n from default_noise_sampler (seeded from extra_args seed; seed+1 on CPU).

props.final_sigma0: Explicit: σ_down=0 returns x'=D with no noise.
props.flow_const: Dispatches at entry to sample_euler_ancestral_RF when model_sampling is CONST (core-euler-ancestral-rf).
